description: Fetch the full USPTO prosecution/transaction history for one patent application — every dated event the Office recorded against the case (filings, mailings, fee payments, office actions, notices, the grant itself), newest first. This is a superset of the handful of events `get_patent` surfaces: use this tool when the question is about the PROSECUTION HISTORY itself (how many office actions, when was it mailed, when did examination start) rather than just the current status.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key. Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/myodp.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, newest first (default 50). The full history is usually under 100 events; a `note` in the response says when more exist than were returned.

number.description: US application number, digits only or formatted. Examples: "18926509", "16/123,456".

name: get_patent_transactions
title: Get Patent Transactions
